commentary_title: Suezmax rates firm up as loadings increase in the West
commentary_summary: The Suezmax tonne-miles index increased in week 32, ending at 114.7 points, rising by close to 13 points from the previous week. | Suezmax earnings have been firming up on most major routes as vessel loadings jumped in week 32. In particular, trade from West Africa to the UKC saw robust activity last week, and the tonnage supply increasingly tightened as the week went by. | Freight rates will likely remain firm next week with an upward push from the active VLCC market.
